'''''Labyrinth of Evil''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[James Luceno]]. It serves as a direct prequel to the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], and it was first published on [[January 25]], [[2005]] by [[Del Rey]].

An [[Labyrinth of Evil (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook]] was released in 2007.  In [[2008]], ''Labyrinth of Evil'' was collected in ''[[The Dark Lord Trilogy]]'', a volume that also included the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] by [[Matthew Stover]] and the novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', by Luceno.

The novel and an [[Labyrinth of Evil (unabridged audiobook)|unabridged audiobook]] was released by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[August 11]], [[2026]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''.<ref name="Penguin-ELC" />
